title: Balanced coarse split frames: conditional κ = 5.1745625472866e-5
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This composes PR #69’s balanced coarse sums and a bounded adaptation of PR #70’s carry exchanges with the anchored split frames from #71. The finite conditional witness gives **κ = 25872812736433/500000000000000000 = 5.1745625472866e-5**, a **0.6437453019850683%** increase over the complete published #71 witness frozen at `1bef94fd40a746452548c84a4a8f8834670a3113`, observed on 2026-10-08. This is a historical comparison; later community improvements are outside this package. The full old recursive child list is strictly excluded at the new bit saving `51748303221339/10^18`.

The result remains conditional on the inherited ordered residual compiler, all-size recursion, routing, prime selection, recovery, finite scalar alphabet/tape, and analytic transfer interfaces. No global optimum, measured practical speedup or complete formal multiplication theorem is claimed. This separate package is stacked on #71 and preserves its exact published source and finite evidence at `1bef94fd40a746452548c84a4a8f8834670a3113`.

### Construction

Keep the anchored `[1,1,2]` split vector, h23 `cover-core` / h25 `reverse-node` schedules, exact profile-cost reclamation and pending controls with both frame-containment checks. For h23, coarse cells use columns when `i+j<ng-1` and rows otherwise; h25 uses rows throughout. Both axes choose independent unit-completion rows using fixed compatible future uses. The h25 carry exchange uses exact integer prices and a three-pass limit, accepting 1,000 legal exchanges.

| Quantity | Published #71 | This witness |
|---|---:|---:|
| h23 auxiliary roles | 27,455 | 27,297 |
| h25 auxiliary roles | 36,015 | 35,684 |
| Physical width W | 135,075,665 | 134,126,064 |
| Total recursive rank | 77,666,660,475 | 77,120,639,900 |
| Rank deficit | 1,846,900 | 1,846,900 |
| Bit wire bits | 28 | 27 |

All physical XORs, frame raises, copies and cleanup are charged. Crossing below 2^27 requires recomputing the bridge: wire bits 27, row coefficient 843, degree 2000, degree gap 7007/25, and suffix slope 8000. The data geometry and complex branch remain inherited. Existing numerical witnesses are unchanged; integration updates only three old root-file source pins and their dependent digest fields.

## Validation

The 245-file source/finite-input freeze is `68a96f879c1501b62da0366ea1003ccf4d4468a2240a70cf020cc9fff9d38471`. Both portable engines differ from the audited discovery source only in the repository-relative ROOT constant. Both selected literal words regenerate byte-for-byte.

- Fresh complete arbitrary-dirty-basis replay in both orientations, literal frame reconstruction, and actual bounded-minor/CRT profile regeneration.
- Full paid child-list reconstruction, independent rational moment enclosures, next 10^-18 bit and κ grid rejection, all 47 strict assembly inequalities and seven margins.
- **24 focused tests**, including physical mutations, missing charges and pins, mass-preserving profile mutation, provider restoration, invalid configurations, optimized-Python rejection, and five stale bridge fields.
- Strategy audits exercise **2,250** independent-prefix completions and literal synthesis, plus **800 random and five targeted** carry-matroid cases with per-exchange legality checks. These tests accompany the proof arguments; they do not replace them.

Independent portable-package review cleared construction `9a58e62cf9e8954a4dde3c9b1372d733c276a6d1`: all 245 working and committed pins match, all 112 archived PR71 files match the published construction, engine relocation is ROOT-only, selected words and complete arithmetic match the independently audited winner, and prior numerical witnesses remain unchanged.

The complete expanded repository verification passed in one clean construction run: **12 verification groups, 563 tests in 82 isolated modules, and 20 patch checks** (1,763.015 seconds). All **39 construction CI checks passed**. Receipt-only commit `79dd6e1` records these results without changing the source freeze or numerical witness. All **39 final-head CI checks passed** at `79dd6e134855bc8a7b8950c3aa0eb279fe148ceb`; the PR is ready for review and mergeable. The new `balanced` CI group retains every inherited group and formal package while keeping compiler regeneration within the existing per-job time limits.

```sh
make balanced-split-verify
make verify
```

See `research/balanced-split/PROOF.md` for the algebra and exact scope, `SOURCE.json` for immutable inputs, and `certificates/balanced-split-validation.json` for focused receipts. Arithmetic cutoffs are not full operational thresholds; inherited Lean checks do not formalize the complete multiplication theorem.
